title: A main push run whose all-jobs-passed and ci-done jobs show skipped is read as green by the merge tool and the red-main read, or the reason is named
why: Sighting (runner 11, 09:17 CST Nov 14, relayed by itself; triage read nothing): degen main push run 974 for 25cfef0e2 completed success, with all-jobs-passed and ci-done both showing "skipped"; the reason is unread. Risk: a rollup job that shows skipped may be read as not green by the red-main read (rule git-red-main-reverts: main's newest finished run) or as unknown by the lane lint (draft_run_state reads a skipped touched job as unknown). Unmeasured; no wrong merge seen. First act of a lane: read the degen workflow's `if:` on those two jobs and what base-red reads for a skipped rollup; reproduce, red then green: a push run with a skipped rollup and green legs reads green (or the reason is printed). Kin: red-gate-reads-suite-run, base-red-reads-gate, push-skip-proven-tree. If it is only degen's own workflow, the fix is in degen. A check change, so round 3 applies if a verdict changes.
